setup: CREATE DATABASE barsql_golden DEFAULT CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci

CREATE TABLE barsql_golden.customers (
			id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
			email VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
			name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'anon',
			mood ENUM('sad', 'happy') NULL,
			created_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
			UNIQUE KEY customers_email_uq (email),
			CONSTRAINT customers_name_check CHECK (CHAR_LENGTH(name) > 0)
		) ENGINE=InnoDB COMMENT='Customers'

CREATE TABLE barsql_golden.orders (
			id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
			customer_id INT NOT NULL,
			total DECIMAL(12,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
			status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'new',
			total_with_tax DECIMAL(12,2) AS (total * 1.2) STORED,
			KEY orders_customer_idx (customer_id),
			CONSTRAINT orders_customer_fk FOREIGN KEY (customer_id) REFERENCES barsql_golden.customers (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
		) ENGINE=InnoDB
CREATE INDEX orders_status_idx ON barsql_golden.orders (status, customer_id)

CREATE VIEW barsql_golden.customer_totals AS SELECT c.id, c.email, COALESCE(SUM(o.total), 0) AS total FROM barsql_golden.customers c LEFT JOIN barsql_golden.orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id, c.email
CREATE TRIGGER barsql_golden.orders_touch BEFORE INSERT ON barsql_golden.orders FOR EACH ROW SET NEW.status = LOWER(NEW.status)
CREATE FUNCTION barsql_golden.add_one(a INT) RETURNS INT DETERMINISTIC RETURN a + 1
CREATE PROCEDURE barsql_golden.reset_status(IN target VARCHAR(20)) UPDATE barsql_golden.orders SET status = target
